briefdescription.para: doInitialization - Virtual method overridden by subclasses to do any necessary initialization before any pass is run.
runOnMachineFunction - This method must be overloaded to perform the desired machine code transformation or analysis.
getAnalysisUsage - Subclasses that override getAnalysisUsage must call this.

detaileddescription.para: For MachineFunctionPasses, calling AU.preservesCFG() indicates that the pass does not modify the MachineBasicBlock CFG.

briefdescription.para: createPrinterPass - Get a machine function printer pass.
runOnFunction - Virtual method overriden by subclasses to do the per-function processing of the pass.
MachineFunctionPass - This class adapts the FunctionPass interface to allow convenient creation of passes that operate on the MachineFunction representation.

detaileddescription.para: Instead of overriding runOnFunction, subclasses override runOnMachineFunction.
